claims.statement: CLEAN step splits the lots with CLN02 mean 511.38 vs CLN01 mean 501.1 and p 0.0165, while DEP p 0.3537 and MET p 0.7433 show no split

After 66.3 CLN02 lots read high on every chamber with 520.67 on DEP02-B and 520.4 on DEP01-B and 521.67 and 521.14 on DEP02-B and 518.73 on DEP02-A and 521.11 on DEP01-B, while interleaved CLN01 lots stayed normal with 503.87 and 499.69 and 499.03 and 499.6
On DEP01-B the same chamber alternated between 502.25 and 520.4 then 499.69 then 521.11, with slope -0.127 showing no drift
FDC sensors on DEP01-B are normal with z 0.1 for heater and 0.7 for power and -1.4 for pressure and 1.8 for flow, yet recent wafers differ with 499.69 vs 521.11
Alarm lot reads 521.11 above spec 485.0 to 515.0

disposition.summary: Alarm lot came from the bad clean tool that is running high on every chamber while the other clean tool stays on target. Chamber sensors are normal and the same chamber alternates between good and high lots, so the chamber is fine. Hold the alarm lot and fix the clean tool.

notes.text: Investigating alarm on LOT-1239 — pulling the alarm details first.
Alarm is out-of-spec high at 521.1 — checking the lot's path to form hypotheses.
Pattern points to the clean tool — verifying chamber history to rule out drift.

truth.explanation: CLN02 started leaving the surface in a state that deposits thick in the center, on every chamber.

public: US Patent 8,718,809, Comprehensive analysis of queue times in microelectronic manufacturing
Film growth can be influenced by the pre-clean to deposition queue time.
Chien, Wang, Cheng (2007), Data mining for yield enhancement in semiconductor manufacturing, Expert Systems with Applications 33(1)

sources.practitioner: Equipment or upstream problems are suspected when abnormal lots cluster in one group. One contact called upstream and shared-facility effects very frequent; the other thought them rare. We keep the scenario and note the disagreement.
